g.text: COMPLETE HARDWARE CONNECTION & PIN MAPPING DIAGRAM
Fingers → Palm → Wrist → Forearm Build Phase (University Robotics Project)
Jetson Orin Nano / Super Nano + ESP32-WROOM-32
9 Servos (5x MG996R, 3x DS3225, 1x DS3218) via PCA9685
ALL GNDs TIE TO ONE COMMON POINT
VAPA ROBOTIC ARM — COMPLETE HARDWARE CONNECTION & PIN MAPPING SCHEMATIC
[ 6V SERVO RAIL | 5V LOGIC RAIL | 12V FUTURE RAIL | ESP32-WROOM-32 | JETSON ORIN NANO | PCA9685 | TCA9548A | AS5600 x4 | FSR402 x5 | ADS1115 | MYOWARE | EEG ]
SET: 6.0V (Calibrate via trim pot with multimeter)
Powers MG996R x5, DS3225 x3, DS3218 x1, PCA9685 V+
SET: 5.0V (Calibrate via trim pot with multimeter)
Powers ESP32 VIN, PCA9685 VCC, 5" HDMI, USB Hub
Connects to Jetson Barrel Jack Centre (+)
CURRENT JETSON POWER SOURCE (OFFICIAL WALL ADAPTER)
Wall Socket (100-240V AC) → Official Jetson Adapter (19V / 3.42A / 65W)
→ Jetson Barrel Jack: 5.5mm outer (STAR GND) / 2.5mm inner (+19V Centre Positive)
Perfboard filter caps installed at barrel input: 470µF 25V Electrolytic + 0.1µF Ceramic (GPU spike absorber)
MANDATORY STAR GROUND BUS (SECTION 1C — PERFBOARD COMMON POINT)
ALL component GND pins connect to a single common point on the perfboard (thick black copper rail).
SECTION 2 — JETSON ORIN NANO & ESP32 PIN MAPPING (PDF SEC 3 & 6)
USB3 Port (Blue): RealSense D435i via USB3 Hub
HDMI Port: 5" HDMI Status Monitor Display
Handles All Sensor Acquisition: EMG, EEG, FSR1..5 → Sends via UART2
Powers ADS1115, EEG, MyoWare x5, FSR top rail
GPIO36: FSR#5 junction point (Little finger force)
NOTE: TX always connects to RX; wires MUST cross. Never TX to TX!
BUILD & TEST PROCEDURE (PDF SECTION 10B STEPS 1 TO 21)
STEP 1-6: Build star ground on perfboard → Calibrate 300W buck to 6.0V → Calibrate LM2596 to 5.0V → Add rail caps (100uF+0.1uF) → Verify with multimeter.
STEP 7-10: Power ESP32 from 5V rail → Wire ADS1115 + MyoWare (add 4.7k pullups) → Flash I2C scanner (expect 0x48) → Add EEG (expect 0x48 + EEG addr).
STEP 11-14: Wire all 5 FSR circuits → Verify ADC readings change with pressure → Connect UART (GPIO16/17 to Pin 8/10 + GND Pin 9) → Verify sensor telemetry.
STEP 15-18: Connect PCA9685 to Jetson I2C (expect 0x40) → Connect TCA9548A (expect 0x40+0x70) → Test single DS3225 on CH5 → Test remaining servos one by one.
STEP 19-21: Connect TCA9548A channels (verify each AS5600 at 0x36) → Connect RealSense D435i via USB3 → Full integration test running simultaneously.
• ESP32 I2C Bus (GPIO21/22): Dedicated to ADS1115 (0x48) + EEG module (0x??). Completely independent from Jetson.
• Jetson I2C Bus 1 (Pins 3/5): Dedicated to PCA9685 (0x40) + TCA9548A Multiplexer (0x70) + 4x AS5600 (0x36 via Mux CH0..3).
SECTION 3 — PCA9685 PWM DRIVER & 9 SERVO CHANNELS (PDF SEC 7 & 8)
Independent PWM for all 9 Servos @ 50Hz (1-2ms pulse)
NOTE ON V+ AND GND CAPACITORS:
Add 1000µF 25V Electrolytic + 0.1µF Ceramic across V+ and GND
ALL pins connected to STAR GROUND BUS
COMPLETE SERVO WIRING (SECTION 8) — 5x FINGERS + 3x WRIST + 1x FOREARM
RED wire NEVER connects to Jetson. Only orange/yellow signal wire touches PCA9685.
SERVO SPIKE ABSORPTION & POWER STABILITY NOTES:
• 100µF 16V Electrolytic Capacitor across RED (+) and BROWN (-) at EVERY servo connector absorbs back-EMF spikes.
• Total 9 Servos in this build phase: 5x MG996R (Fingers) + 3x DS3225 (Wrist) + 1x DS3218 (Forearm).
• 3x DS3218 remaining are explicitly reserved for future elbow build phase.
• Power supplied solely by the high-current 300W 20A Buck regulator set to 6.0V.
SECTION 4 — FSR402 VOLTAGE DIVIDER CIRCUITS (x5) (PDF SEC 4)
EXACT CIRCUIT TOPOLOGY REPEATED 5 TIMES (PDF SECTION 4)
no polarity, either leg either way
Power: ESP32 3V3 rail | Divider: 10k ohm resistor to STAR GND
Filter: 100nF (0.1uF) ceramic cap alongside ADC pin to eliminate analog noise

Filter: 100nF (0.1uF) ceramic cap alongside ADC pin to eliminate analog noise
• No pressure on FSR → FSR resistance HIGH → junction voltage HIGH (~3.3V)
• Full pressure → FSR resistance LOW → junction voltage LOW (~0.3V)
• ESP32 maps this 0-3.3V range to 0-4095 ADC counts = grip force value
SECTION 5 — TCA9548A MULTIPLEXER + AS5600 ENCODERS (PDF SEC 9)
Address: 0x70 (A0=0, A1=0, A2=0 all to STAR GND)
All 4 AS5600 share 0x36; TCA9548A switches channels
VCC: Jetson Pin 1 (3.3V) | GND: STAR GND | DIR: STAR GND (forward)
SDA: TCA9548A SD0 | SCL: TCA9548A SC0 | OUT: Not connected
Mounting: 6mm x 2.5mm diametric magnet glued to shaft; 1.5mm air gap
VCC: Jetson Pin 1 (3.3V) | GND: STAR GND | DIR: STAR GND (forward)
SDA: TCA9548A SD1 | SCL: TCA9548A SC1 | OUT: Not connected
Mounting: 6mm x 2.5mm diametric magnet glued to shaft; 1.5mm air gap
VCC: Jetson Pin 1 (3.3V) | GND: STAR GND | DIR: STAR GND (forward)
SDA: TCA9548A SD2 | SCL: TCA9548A SC2 | OUT: Not connected
Mounting: 6mm x 2.5mm diametric magnet glued to shaft; 1.5mm air gap
VCC: Jetson Pin 1 (3.3V) | GND: STAR GND | DIR: STAR GND (forward)
SDA: TCA9548A SD3 | SCL: TCA9548A SC3 | OUT: Not connected
Mounting: 6mm x 2.5mm diametric magnet glued to shaft; 1.5mm air gap
• MAGNET: 6mm diameter x 2.5mm height diametrically magnetised disc glued to exact centre of servo/gearbox shaft.
• CHIP: AS5600 board mounted FIXED to arm frame (does not rotate), chip face pointing TOWARD the magnet.
• AIR GAP: Exactly 1.5 mm nominal between chip face and magnet bottom (air gap outside 0.5-3mm = unreliable readings).
• CENTRING: Magnet must be centred above chip within 0.5mm; off-centre causes nonlinear angle distortion.
• VCC: Jetson Pin 1 (3.3V only — DO NOT CONNECT TO 5V).
• GND: STAR GROUND BUS on perfboard.
• SDA / SCL: Dedicated SDx and SCx lines from TCA9548A channels 0, 1, 2, 3.
• DIR: Tied to STAR GROUND BUS (sets counting direction = forward).
• OUT: Left open / NOT CONNECTED (analog output not used, read via I2C register 0x0C/0x0D).
SECTION 6 — ADS1115 ADC + MYOWARE EMG + EEG MODULE (PDF SEC 5)
I2C Address: 0x48 (ADDR tied to STAR GND)
16-Bit Precision Delta-Sigma ADC | Managed by ESP32
EEG analog OUT pin (Brain signal analog input)
ADS1115 Analog Input A0 (Analog EMG Envelope: 0 to 3.3V)
• Centre electrode snap: Active pad — placed over muscle belly (detects muscle activation)
• End snap 1: Reference pad — placed 2cm along muscle
• End snap 2: Ground pad — placed on bony area nearby (elbow or wrist bone)
Muscle signals decoded by ESP32 ADC and transmitted to Jetson Orin Nano for grip state control.
ESP32 GPIO21 (I2C data line — shared bus)
ESP32 GPIO22 (I2C clock line — shared bus)
ADS1115 Analog Input A1 (Use if EEG module outputs analog voltage)
Check your EEG module datasheet first. If it has SDA/SCL pins use I2C connection. If it has an OUT pin use ADS1115 A1.
• ESP32 handles analog conversion or digital reading at 100 Hz and sends formatted packets over UART to Jetson.
